༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi don 'grel bzhugs so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni/ /bdag sogs dus mtha'i gdul bya'i don slad du/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi don 'grel bzhugs so// rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni/ /bdag sogs dus mtha'i gdul bya'i don slad du/ /mngon sum dge ba'i bshes kyi tshul 'dzin pa/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams brtse'i dbang phyug snying gi ma ṇi ka /bka' drin mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes khyod la/ /sdeb legs tshig gi srad bu la brgyus pa'i/ /legs bshad me tog gsar pa'i skyes 'di 'bul/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam/ /gsang chen gdams pa rgya mtsho'i snying po'i bcud/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i nye lam mchog /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob byed pa'i/ /nges gsang lam gyi thabs mkhas ji snyed kyi/ /gnad don ma lus tshang ba'i nyams len yin/ /lam gyi skyabs yul dkon mchog rnam gsum dang / /'bras bu'i skyabs yul sku gsum la sogs pa/ /skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i gsang gsum la/ /tshang ba'i tshul 'di legs par rtogs gyur na/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo bo gcig yin pas/ /lam gyi chos rnams bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /gzhi yi chos kun rang gi phung khams la/ /tshang ba'i blo 'di shugs kyis skye bar 'gyur/ /sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bla ma'i lam gyis rdzogs/ /dngos gzhi rim gnyis bla ma'i lam la tshang / /'bras bu sku gnyis bla ma'i lam gyis thob/ /de'i phyir 'di la thams cad tshang zhes bya/ /smin byed dbang bzhi bla ma'i lam gyis thob/ /grol byed lam bzhi bla ma'i lam la tshang / /spang bya sgrib bzhi bla ma'i lam gyis spong / /gnas skabs las bzhi bla ma'i lam gyis 'grub/ /mthar thug sku bzhi bla ma'i lam gyis thob/ /de'i phyir 'di la thams cad tshang zhes bya/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ /bla ma'i sku la tshang bar yid ches nas/ /sku yi byin rlabs ma lus oṃ yig gi/

/rnam pas rang gi dpral bar thim pa'i mod/ /sbyang gzhi phung khams skye mched sum cu gnyis/ /sbyang 'bras lha yi ngo bor thag bcad nas/ /mnyam rjes kun tu ma brjed skyong shes na/ /bum dbang smin grol 'bras bcas de la tshang / /de bzhin yi ge khams dang rlung sogs kyi/ /gdan gsum dag bya dag byed ngo sprad de/ /byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du blangs nas ni/ /sku bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i thabs shes na/ /smin grol lam gyi zab gnad ma lus pa/ /thams cad 'di la tshang ba yin zhes bya/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems bsres nas ni/ /rig pa'i ye shes rang ngo mthong ba na/ /kun 'byung dug lnga sdug bsngal phung po lnga/ /ma spangs lha dang ye shes chen po yi/ /ngo bor gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul/ /snang srid dag mnyam chen po'i ltad mo 'di/ /mngon sum mthong na dbang bzhi'i lam gnad kun/ /'di la 'dus kyi gzhan rnams spros pa tsam/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal mgon bla ma zhes/ /brjod pa gzhan gyi lad mo ma yin par/ /mchog gsum yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bla ma mchog las gzhan du mi rnyed pa'i/ /yid ches dad pa'i nges pa bskyed nas ni/ /dngos gzhi lha yi bsgom bzlas byed pa dang / /thun mtshams kha zas gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /'phro rgod nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa dang / /skye 'chi bar do'i 'khrul snang la sogs pa/ /zab mo bla ma'i lam du 'khyer shes na/ /snang srid bla mar shar ba'i nyams len 'dis/ /lhan skyes bde chen rig stong gnyug ma'i gshis/ /nges pa don gyi bla ma rin po che'i/ /rang zhal mjal nas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ma dag rang sems tha mal lus pa'i tshe/ /spangs rtogs yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /khyad par med pa'i dpal mgon bla ma yang / /gang zag phal pa'i tshul du mthong bar 'gyur/ /bar du sems nyid cung zad sbyang ba na/ /dam pa'i mgon de sprul pa'i sku ru mthong /

/sems nyid shin tu dag pa'i gnas skabs na/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru snang / /nam zhig dgongs pa dbyer med gyur pa na/ /chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /bla ma'i dgongs pa sangs rgyas dngos yin yang / /blo yi rim pas du mar snang ba lags/ /tshul 'di zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /dbang po rab kyi lam gyi dngos gzhi zhes/ /skyon med grub pa'i dbang phyug sa skya pa/ /gong ma'i gsung gi dgongs pa yin nam snyam/ /'khor 'das gnyis po rtog pas btags pa tsam/ /dge dang sdig pa sems snang tsam du zad/ /bskal pa'i yun dang che chung bzang ngan sogs/ /thams cad blos brtags yin gyi don la med/ /'di 'dra'i tshul la nges pa bskyed nas ni/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin sgyu mar shes pa'i blos/ /dper na stan thog gcig gi nyams len gyi/ /sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i thabs mkhas des/ /las nyon 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sbyangs pa dang / /rgya chen tshogs gnyis lam du byed pa'i tshul/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med don rtogs na/ /'bad pa chung ngus tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /bdud tshogs sems snang yin par ma shes na/ /ji ltar btul kyang 'dul bar mi nus bzhin/ /tshogs gnyis rang snang yin par ma shes na/ /ji ltar bsgrubs kyang rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rim par brgyud pa yi/ /snyan brgyud zab mo'i gdams pa 'di yod na/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yis lcags khams ji bzhin du/ /mi bzod las ngan bsod nams tshogs su 'gyur/ /de bzhin srung 'khor gzhal yas khang sogs kyis/ /bdud tshogs 'dul dang zhing khams sbyong ba sogs/ /dag bya dag byed sbyor ba'i tshul shes na/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang thob la mi ring nye/ /gang zhig phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung lugs bzhin/ /mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba'i dka' spyad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /myur yang grangs med gsum du tshogs bsag dgos/

/gal te rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /zab mo nang gi de nyid shes gyur na/ /'dod yon lam khyer gsang sngags thabs mkhas kyis/ /tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs/ /'khrul snang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun gyi rgyu/ /yun ring spang dka' nyon mongs dug lnga po/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rang ngo shes pa'i tshe/ /ye shes lnga yin logs na ye shes med/ /ma dag las nyon rgyu las grub pa yi/ /rang lus rtsa sogs dkyil 'khor bzhi po 'di/ /dag pa ye shes chen po'i rang gzugs kyi/ /rgyal ba sku bzhi zhes pa'ang 'di rang lags/ /bdud dang gdug rtsub lha 'dres 'tshe ba yang / /nang gi nyon mongs dug lnga'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /rnam dag rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor yang / /rang sems dag pa'i snang brnyan tsam du bas/ /'khor 'das phyi ru bzung nas re dogs kyis/ /ngal ba'i khur chen 'dzin pa spangs nas ni/ /gnyis med sems kyi de nyid mthong ba na/ /'khrul snang dgag sgrub ngang gis zhig par 'gyur/ /srin bu'i kha chus rang lus bcing ba ltar/ /rang gi rtog pas rang nyid bslus pa'i tshul/ /dam pa'i drin gyis legs par rtogs gyur na/ /spang dang thob ces bya ba tha snyad tsam/ /dge ba'i sems kyis bde skyid mi tshol bar/ /'bad pa'i sgo brgyas phun tshogs sgrub pa ltar/ /zab mo nang gi rten 'brel mi shes par/ /sangs rgyas phyi ru btsal ba'ang de dang 'dra/ /kha zas rang gis za ba spangs nas ni/ /rang gi gzugs brnyan zas kyis skyong ba ltar/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mi mchod par/ /de yi gzugs brnyan mchod pa nyon re mongs/ /lus 'di rgyal ba kun gyi pho brang ste/ /sa dang lam gyi gter mdzod lus 'di yin/ /sangs rgyas thob pa lus 'di'i drin yin pas/ /lus la brnyas pa dug bzhin spong bar mdzod/ /sde snod gsum dang rnam bzhi'i rgyud sde yi/ /brjod bya theg gsum lam gyi rtogs pa'i rigs/

/sdom pa gsum sogs rnam byang chos rnams kun/ /rig thog gcig tu dril la nyams su longs/ /dal 'byor rten thob chos dang bla ma bzang / /mthun rkyen legs tshogs gang la bsams kyang rung / /rten 'brel 'di 'dra phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /yun ring 'tsho ba'i thugs bskyed cis kyang mdzod/ /bdag kyang 'di 'dra'i tshul la bslabs nas ni/ /myur du snying po'i btsan sa 'dzin 'dod kyang / /'khrul rtog yan par shor ba'i gzhan dbang 'dis/ /yang dag lam tu gtong bar dka' ba 'dra/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung la cung zad sbyangs na yang / /sgom pa'i nyams myong bdag la ma mchis pas/ /go yul tshig gi lam la zhen pa yi/ /rtog ge'i tshig la yid rton 'cha' ba las/ /dam pa khyed kyis da lta'i mdzad pa bzhin/ /da dung sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig dang / /kho thag nang nas chod pa'i nyams myong zhig /'byung ba rten 'brel zab mo'i che ba lags/ /gting mtha' mi mngon srid pa'i rgya mtsho che/ /sdug bsngal bye ba'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba 'di/ /rang blo rmongs pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam zhig las/ /gzhan du grub pa yod tshod mi 'dra bas/ /kun rmongs srid pa'i mun pa 'joms pa la/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar dang 'grogs pa/ /mkhyen pa'i gter gyur rje btsun bla ma dang / /dbyer med a ma'i zla ba ma lags sam/ /'di bgyis pa las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /yid mthun chos kyi grogs po khyed dang ngas/ /yun ring sgrub pa'i dam bca' mthar phyin nas/ /spangs rtogs yon tan yongs su rdzogs par shog /'di snang nub nas phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams la sogs par/ /rje btsun bla ma bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung du/ /ngo shes bzhin du bdag cag 'phrad par shog /de nas mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rgyal kun gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba dang / /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa blta ba'i phyir/ /bdag cag gnyis po lhan du 'dong bar shog

/rab zhi chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /mkha' khyab gdul bya'i bsam pa dang 'tshams par/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol pa bsam yas kyis/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las lhan du skyong bar shog /g.yo med lhag bsam bzang po'i mthu stobs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bla ma mchog gsum lha yi byin mthu yis/ /ji skad smon pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig /tshul 'di rje btsun bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /'khrul med dpal ldan sa skya'i rang lugs la/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa'i skal bzang po/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga'i ming gis bris/ /shin tu dge zhing bkra shis dpal 'bar shog/ //dge'o// //dge'o// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sde ston a 'jam/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi don 'grel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
